newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RMB to create banking unit for individuals.
newsitem.headline: RMB to create banking unit for individuals.

text.p: South Africa's Rand Merchant Bank Holdings Limited (RMB) said on Monday it planned to invest 500 million rand over five years in a bid to launch a division servicing individuals early next year.

The bank said the creation of the new division had been motivated by its research which showed that not all people were satisfied with their commerical banks and would prefer the advice of a merchant bank.
"In contrast to the predominantly product focused commercial banks the new RMB unit is customer focused," RMB's managing director Paul Harris said in a statement.

"Commerical banks are...inherently product focused, both in their structure and systems. Their products are also mostly commodities by nature and are very difficult to convert to personalised solutions," he added.
